description: Today, Monique DeSpain received the endorsement of the leading group representing the voice of Oregon small and independent business owners, the National Federation of Independent Businesses (NFIB), with over 1000 member businesses in Oregon’s Fourth Congressional District. DeSpain’s opponent, incumbent Representative Val Hoyle, has received a dismal 14 out of 100 rating based on her voting record in Congress on key legislation impacting small businesses.
